user.title: NGED power cuts
user.description: Watch National Grid Electricity Distribution's live power cut feed for one home. NGED covers the Midlands, South West England and South Wales. The data comes from [NGED Connected Data]({dataset_url}).

data_description.postcode: The home's postcode. NGED lists the postcodes affected by each power cut.
data_description.latitude: Used to find power cuts near home. Defaults to the Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Used to find power cuts near home. Defaults to the Home Assistant location.
data_description.radius_km: Power cuts within this distance of home count as nearby.

error.invalid_postcode: That doesn't look like a UK postcode.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the NGED power cut feed. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This postcode is already set up.
